entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Sri Avanish Pratap Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri J.P. Gupta, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present application U/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been field with the prayer to quash the cognizance order dated 05.01.2019 as well as entire proceeding arising out of Case Crime No. 437 of 2018,
under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 P.O.C.S.O. Act, Police Station New Agra,
District Agra, pending in the court of Additional Sessions Judge, Agra.

entities.text:
Police Station New Agra,
District Agra
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the victim is now major and she has solemnized marriage with the applicant on 22.05.2018 and the marriage was duly registered at Aligarh.

It is further submitted that both the parties are living as husband and wife happily and one Sanjay vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156118393/
1 daughter and one son were also born with the wedlock of applicant and victim.

entities.text: one Sanjay vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On being asked, victim has stated that the marriage was solemnized with the applicant with her own free consent and she is enjoying happy married life and has no grievance with the applicant.
She has further stated that she does not want to prosecute the applicant in the present case.

Opposite party no. 4 namely Smt. Madhu, who is informant and mother of victim has also stated that both the applicant and her daughter are living as husband and wife for the last about five years and now she does not want to prosecute the applicant in the present case.

Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, since the applicant and victim got married and are residing as husband and wife for last five years and two children were also born and they are leading a happy married life and opposite party no. 2 informant as well as victim do not want to prosecute the applicant in this case, the present petition is liable to be allowed.
In view of above, the application is allowed and the entire further proceeding relating to aforesaid case crime number are hereby quashed.
